title: Hafnerweg, Baden-Baden
description:
Beautiful fully furnished top floor apartment. 
This apartment boasts a beautiful rustic design.

This wonderful property features large window panes that glare natural light into the space, beautiful decoration, comfortable furniture, a fully equipped kitchen to cook anything you please, public parking on the street, simply put, a lovely long-term stay!

The apartment has 1 big open room and 2nd room which is the bedroom (4 beds in total), kitchen, TV and WIFI. 

The surrounding neighbourhood is best described as suburban, meaning that it is calm and residential. Here you will be able to go on relaxing strolls and lead a calm life.
The apartment is located 500m from the hospital and is near the forest. 
Very safe and quiet neighbourhood. 
Washing machine and dishwasher are available in the apartment.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!
